name: ci-ownership-history
goal: CI full checks read immutable ownership review commits without changing credentials or verification scope

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: GitHub Full check at 349b5fea5 rejects the guard because shallow checkout omits review commit 16ab6fdf6. Both jobs must read immutable review history without write credentials.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard Linux setup coverage checked tools and execution only; macOS alone checked complete source history. Extend the same Linux case with full-history and credential-removal assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red ff85d2b4 at c102508bf: the standard Linux checkout case requires immutable ownership review commits. This step is recorded at its actual tested commit.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Commit 2bfd74bc5 fetches full source history for the existing Linux check, retaining exact revision selection, read-only permissions and removed persisted credentials.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed unchanged green 62c065e2 at 2bfd74bc5 passes all six CI setup cases. The four normal CI, ownership and runner files pass 26 cases. Broader verification remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
